summary: Iteration 2: tested the three new EPOHTECH features (home client credibility strip, program cohort detail pages with sticky registration form, admin EPOHTECH Enquiries tab) plus light regression on Anvaya / and /admin. Backend pytest regression: 5/5 pass. Frontend Playwright: all new flows pass — client strip renders between hero and services with Dawn Fresh, Volt & Valve and '+ every Anvaya Partners company'; both program cards read 'VIEW PROGRAM & REGISTER' and navigate to correct slug; Big Data + Oracle Fusion detail pages show back link, title, 4 fact cards, 5 numbered curriculum modules, who-it's-for list and sticky form; unknown slug redirects to /epohtech/programs; consent-gated program registration submits and shows epoh-program-register-success; admin dashboard shows QA Program Tester enquiry with interest 'Big Data Engineering Program' under EPOHTECH Enquiries tab; Messages tab (data-testid=admin-messages-list) and all other tabs render without errors; /, /admin, /epohtech and /epohtech/contact load without page errors. No revenue stats on EPOHTECH pages.
critical_code_review_comments: EpohProgramDetailPage `PROGRAMS` dict is co-located with the page — if a third program is added, consider hoisting to /data or /content so the listing page and detail page share a single source of truth (currently PROGRAMS is duplicated across EpohProgramsPage.js and EpohProgramDetailPage.js).
Program registration success panel does not offer a 'register another' or navigate-away CTA — user is stuck on the success card until manual navigation.
server.py POST /api/epoh/enquiry still accepts consent=false silently (carry-over from iteration_1); low priority since UI gates it, but recommend server-side 400 for defense in depth.
